learning_outcomes.text: Apply fundamental materials science knowledge to the metallic materials covered.
Explain the microstructure of the metallic materials covered.
Distinguish between various surface treatments and use them to specifically alter material properties on steel surfaces.
Name essential material properties and differences of the metallic materials covered and their resulting applications.
Make a rough material selection for practical use, considering mechanical and/or corrosive stress.
Work independently in the field of metallic materials.
Take responsibility for the services provided.
Work on and solve tasks related to metallic materials, also in teams.
Act fairly and cooperatively and be able to deal with conflicts appropriately.
Actively contribute to the development of metallurgical topics.

syllabus_topics: Independent knowledge acquisition on a specific topic or strengthening of research competence
Familiarization with new topics and critical questioning
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam. Successful participation in the practical work for the course is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
